comparison.objective: Cock a sprung phone holder, place a phone and trigger its arms; candidate adjusts and validates a hydraulic damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Opening coupled arms and centering a phone against a trigger versus tool-mediated screw release, fine collar rotation, socket reacquisition and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Phone must be edge-clamped, stable and released without a fall or glass-face strike; candidate instead requires repeatable axial stopping under explicit force and travel limits.
comparison.reason: The shared spring/latch and release primitives do not test damper commissioning or measured dynamic response.
